platform_limitations.risk: Platform rate limiting or account creation limits
platform_limitations.mitigation: Stagger account creation, use different IP addresses, monitor limits

verification_issues.mitigation: Have backup email accounts, multiple phone numbers, manual verification process

username_conflicts.mitigation: Have alternative username options prepared, use slight variations

security_concerns.mitigation: Enable 2FA immediately, use strong passwords, secure credential storage

technical_issues.mitigation: Have flexible timeline, monitor platform status, have backup schedule

qualitative_metrics.security: All accounts have proper security measures
